notes.title: Update (V1.0.12) "I'm bug huntin'"
notes.content:
Wow!  Thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBk6-z6v3pDL9c3YZmQNpyJQp7bpcAK3G]Alex Diener's fantastic videos[/url], a whole new group of people have been exposed to No Anglerfish!

We've learned so much thanks to his "let's play"s, as well as comments from fans (hopefully fans?) in [url=https://discord.gg/9kCWX2an]our discord[/url] - and have discovered very unexpected "bugs" here and there.  Mostly due to people playing in orders and ways we never expected - awesome!

This update fixes a couple of these discovered "bugs" as well as corrects some spelling errors that never made it to our beta testers because they were so deeply hidden in No Anglerfish lore and bonus content!

As always, we sincerely appreciate knowing that people are enjoying the game.

Peace.

notes.title: Update (V1.0.10)
notes.content: In this update using a hint will not permanently lock you out of content.

notes.title: Update V1.0.08
notes.content:
Hey folks, we've made what we feel are good and sensible updates to the game's user experience.

This update reflects the fact that players are unfortunately more able to accidentally accept "hints" than we expected.  As such, the game now requires that you HOLD the (H)int button for a couple seconds before it reveals the hint.

Note please that using hints does NOT prevent you from accessing any significant content in the game!

Thanks again for playing!

notes.title: V1.0.06 update!
notes.content:
Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where one specific puzzle could crash the game.
[*] You can now be forgiven by one character for transgressing against them.  Previously you would lose the ability to ever become friends with them again.
[*] Undo no longer removes the ability to achieve "all complete" on a puzzle.
[*] Z key can be swapped with the E key for certain keyboards.
[/list]

notes.title: First update! Version 1.0.02b
notes.content: This is hopefully a very minor update from an end user perspective.  In playtesting we found one puzzle that was just a grind, so we modified it to have four unique steps instead of three repetitions of the first step.  We also found a spot that could "feel" like a soft lock that we have added a short timer before a clue is provided.  Finally we added two new friends to the end credits to help thank them for their work in getting the update posted!
